atfork_integration_finding.defect: Legacy _pthread_fork_prepare invokes registered client callbacks after malloc/dispatch locks are held; parent legacy wrapper invokes client callbacks before those locks are released
atfork_integration_finding.remediation: Split handlers from genuine pthread internal locks: prepare handlers first/internal pthread last; parent internal pthread first/handlers last; child reset main dyld and System Mach state, then pthread/subsystems, handlers last
